relations.subject: Adinatha Neminatha Upadhye
relations.evidence: Upadhye began his career as a Lecturer of Prakrit at Rajaram College, Kolhapur in 1930. He served full 32 years in Rajaram College... He retired from Rajaram College in 1962 after 32 years of loyal service.

relations.subject: Adinatha Neminatha Upadhye
relations.evidence: and received D.Litt. Degree from Bombay University in 1939.

relations.subject: Adinatha Neminatha Upadhye
relations.evidence: He dedicated himself as Springer Research Scholar of Bombay University from 1939 to 1942.

relations.subject: Adinatha Neminatha Upadhye
relations.evidence: Later, he joined Shivaji University as a Professor Emeritus from 1962 to 1971, during this period he served as Dean of Arts Department as well.

relations.subject: Adinatha Neminatha Upadhye
relations.evidence: He worked closely with A. G Pawar, then Vice-Chancellor of Shivaji University and also worked hard to lay a strong foundation for newly formed University.
